#[kani::proof]
fn cover_pass_compact() {
    let value: u8 = kani::any();
    kani::assume(value <= 1);
    if value > 1 {
        assert!(false, "an ordinary assertion outside the admitted domain");
    }
    kani::cover!(value == 0, "zero is admitted");
    kani::cover!(value == 1, "one is admitted");
}
